history.summary: Homes, parties, trophy fish you can see and a fresh new look.
added: Open /homes to save, rename or visit your three starter homes.
Use /party or /group to manage your party and see your teammates' health on wide, easy-to-read bars.
Click a rally card with chat open to request travel to its author. They choose whether to accept.
Relic lanterns, the travel staff and the wanderer's circlet now have useful bonuses.

Trophy fish look as big as they weigh, from a hand-sized Rare to a huge Legendary, and take on their rarity colour: in your hand, on the ground, in frames and on the cutting board, with a rarity glow and the weight right on the inventory icon. Fish of 10 kg and more are lifted over your head with both hands, so the off hand stays free of anything else meanwhile.
New ultra-rare Mythic fish: 40 kg and up, a red name, and the whole server hears about it.
Legendary and Mythic names shimmer in chat, in tooltips and even in death messages when someone finishes you off with a fish.
Fish weigh by rarity: Rare 1-2.99 kg, Epic 3-19.99 kg, Legendary 20-40 kg. About one trophy in 250 comes up Shiny, with stronger effects, its own jingle and extra sparkles.
Rare catches get a personal card above the hotbar with a chime. Use /catchcards off to silence them.
Boomboxes work in water and stay on the same station after a meal. Six can be powered per chunk, with six audio streams across the server.
Armor now looks 3D on you and everyone else, dyes and trims included (3D Armor). Gameplay stays the same.
Saved skins return on rejoin; maps and statistics use your selected skin with clearer guides and layouts.
Celebration fireworks from events, daily gifts and secret codes look and sound the same but never hurt anyone.
The secret code of the day changes at midnight Riga time and needs 20 minutes of active play that day (new players: 2 hours in total first).
On the world map, right-click a player to send them a /tpa request; admin-only teleports stay hidden.
Your death marker on the map disappears by itself once all the items you dropped are picked up or gone.

Each kind of trophy fish does its own thing: effects when eaten (some bite back) and bonuses while held, all listed in the tooltip. Cooking keeps the stats and makes effects last longer. On the cutting board heavier fish give more slices over several cuts (the board shows how many cuts are left, and a half-cut fish fills you up less), and every slice keeps the rarity, the Shiny star and a share of the effects. Bigger fish fill you up more.
Fresh boombox: a flat icon in your inventory, a 3D boombox you carry at your hip by the handle that swings as you walk and turn, speakers that pulse with the music and notes that pop on the beat.
Entering a structure (villages, dungeons, Ancient Cities) shows its name; zone titles are colour-coded and easier to read.

Login screen, party panel, catch and reward cards and menus share a sharper black-and-gold Holy Lois look: yes-buttons are green, cancel and delete are red, menus fit their content, and the daily reward card fades in above the hotbar with the Holy Lootbox in sight all week.
Smoother animations: maps held up in front of you, food at your mouth while eating and lanterns that swing smoothly, in first and third person.
The AFK camera now starts a few seconds after you cast a line or when you are marked AFK, not after 30 seconds of standing still.
Chests no longer replay their closing animation when you look back at them.
Your party's marker through walls sits on their head, and elytra flight feels smoother.
Enter confirms login, register, home names and party invites; alt-tab no longer pauses the game.
Joining shows the resource download on the loading bar with a short status line instead of a corner popup.
Fish of Thieves tropical islands and fruit trees no longer appear in new land, so the world keeps its vanilla look.
Fishy Business counts Fish of Thieves fish too, and the illager camp achievement is now called Find an Illager Camp.

The way in is one smooth scene: our own panorama on the title screen, while connecting and behind the login form, then a soft fade into the world. The title screen has a Holy Lois: Reborn button that joins straight away.
Enter works in every form again, and Esc on the login screen asks whether to leave the server.
The day-7 Holy Lootbox is its own gold block with the Holy Lois logo, like the one on the website, and bursts open with gold sparks.
A boombox playing in your hand pumps its speakers and pops notes on the beat too, and lanterns in hand swing smoothly like the boombox.

history.summary: Keep your name and progress, with smoother login and inventory controls.
added: Quick start accepts valid names without a Minecraft ownership check. Existing Holy Lois accounts still need their server password.
Launcher setup keeps every shortcut option reachable while you enter your name.
Admin-requested name changes keep your inventory, homes and progress. Previous names stay protected.
Recover a server password through a private form and one-use code from an admin.
Login no longer triggers false flying kicks, and account changes cannot bypass combat restrictions.
R sorts from an empty slot without opening a recipe when an item moves under the cursor.
Matching runestones stack more reliably when taken from chests. Different special variants stay separate.

history.summary: Party up, find your friends, and get back to the adventure.
updated: Party members are protected from friendly fire, with an optional health and food panel.
Use /rally to share a meeting point with your party for 90 seconds.
Daily supplies appear in a clear reward card, with daily coins claimed through their existing reward system.
Voice chat can recover its connection after login; /voicefix requests another attempt.
Cleaner login messages and matching release news across the website and launcher.

history.summary: Relics survive placement, crate rewards work, and combat teleports stay blocked.
updated: Place and recover relic lanterns with their original name, lore and components, including after a server restart
Fishing Crates compatibility: intended enchantments, stack counts and loot conditions work on Minecraft 26.3
Combat checks cover typed commands, aliases, accepted requests and delayed teleports
Login and registration suppress world audio while keeping interface clicks and personal volume settings
First-person body remains active with held tools; aiming pose aligns with the camera without changing saved settings
Singleplayer world preparation avoids the installed REI shared-tag reload race
Clearer claim protection messages in English, Russian and Latvian
Owner and test accounts are excluded from statistics and Tab rankings without deleting game progress
Claim permissions cover placed-boombox controls and protected-mob pushing/damage; at most two placed speakers play per chunk
Selected server skins supply statistics head images; skin storage stays with SkinsRestorer
The Minecraft window icon uses the largest handmade image as its base

history.summary: Fishing on Holy Lois: new fish, loot crates on the hook, legends hidden in chests, and every fish you catch has a size.
added: Fish of Thieves 26.3.0.1-fabric: ten kinds of fish in many colours, each with its own waters (biomes, night, storms)
Fishing Crates 1.3.1: now and then a crate comes up on the hook

Fish sizes: every fish is Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic or Legendary. Rare and better keep their weight in kg and your name and do not stack, so they are trophies. A Legendary catch is announced to everyone
Legends: rare named items with old inscriptions in dungeon, tavern and town chests, some only from the sea. Each belongs to a legend; find a whole set for an achievement
Fishing treasure can be a message in a bottle or a map to buried treasure
New achievements: Touched by Legend, one per legend, Message in a Bottle, Fish Story and The One That Didn't Get Away
updated: Holy Lois Extras 1.6.0: legends, fishing treasure and fish sizes on the server; the mod check always lets the game's own built-in parts through

history.summary: Quick Play is removed: it never joined the server by itself. Play opens your Minecraft launcher, then join Holy Lois from Multiplayer.
removed: Quick Play (launcher 1.2.6 and Holy Lois Extras 1.5.0): in testing the game never joined by itself, so Play did the same as before. Launcher 1.2.7 drops the setting and deletes the leftover holylois-quickplay.json
updated: Holy Lois Extras 1.5.1 without the Quick Play part. A real one-click start, where the launcher starts the game itself, is coming later

history.summary: Quick Play: the launcher now sends you straight into Holy Lois. AFK time stops counting, new icons and a hidden daily code.
added: Quick Play: click Play and the game joins Holy Lois by itself from the title screen, for premium and offline accounts (Settings in the launcher: Quick Play or Standard)
Launcher 1.2.6: closes Minecraft and its launcher for you when an update needs it, after you press Agree
/redeem CODE: a secret code of the day is hidden somewhere on holylois.com. One prize per player per day
New icons for the Minecraft window and the launcher
updated: AFK time no longer counts as playing: achievements, land claims, leaderboards, stats and the Tab list skip it
World generation no longer overloads the server while the border grows

history.summary: A bigger, bolder crown for the Minecraft window icon and a greener Play button in the launcher.
updated: The Minecraft window and taskbar icon is bigger: the crown now fills the whole icon, with wider battlements like the logo
Launcher 1.2.5: a stronger green Play button and the same bigger crown icon

history.summary: A sharp new crown icon on the game window, a server that only lets the Holy Lois pack in, and clearer dungeon achievements.
added: The server checks that everyone plays the Holy Lois pack: a player with extra mods is turned away with a message that says how to fix it. Shaders, resource packs and your own settings stay yours
Launcher Play button: moves extra mods out of the Holy Lois folder (kept, not deleted), repairs changed pack files and switches the pack resource packs back on
updated: The Minecraft window and taskbar icon is now the Holy Lois crown, drawn pixel-perfect so it is crisp at every size
New server icon in the multiplayer list
Clearer achievement texts for Discoverer, Dungeon Delver, Deeper Still and Odd Pillar

history.summary: Fixes from the 1.7.6 test: the first-person body can sink into a wall a little, a clear view in bed, dynamic lights that follow your shader setting, and a friendlier tool swap line.
updated: Tool swap says "Switched to Iron Pickaxe"
First person: the body may sink into a wall a little instead of being pushed all the way forward
In bed the camera is lifted a little above the pillow so your eyes are not inside your head

Dynamic lights follow the shader state: with a shader pack on, the first-person light is off (the shader lights what you hold) and dropped torches and mobs still glow; with shaders off, dynamic lights are fully on, including the first-person light. If they were switched off, they are switched back on

history.summary: Dungeon achievements, a boombox that reaches much further, tool swaps that leave your enchanted tools alone and a handful of fixes.
added: Server: every dungeon (small, medium, large, obelisks) is announced when someone first finds it, with new achievements: Dungeon Delver, Deeper Still, Dungeon Master and Odd Pillar
Server: dungeon chests can now drop Runeforged runes, the treasure rooms the best ones
updated: Boombox: the range now goes from 16 blocks (volume 1) to 48 blocks (volume 10)
A broken tool is replaced by an unenchanted spare of the same kind (lowest material first). Enchanted tools are never swapped in for you
R on an empty slot sorts without also opening a recipe
First person: the body steps forward when a wall is behind you and stays hidden while you sleep
Torches light yellow with a shader pack on (dynamic lights pause while shaders are on and come back when they are off)
Holy Lois mods now show the logo, author and links in Mod Menu
Server list line shortened so it fits

history.summary: Boombox volume and new stations, a smarter R key and tool swaps, /home picks your main home, portals that bring you back and a bigger world.
added: Boombox: sneak + scroll changes the volume (1-10, louder also reaches further), music notes float while it plays, and 6 new stations: dubstep, drum and bass, trap, lo-fi, hardstyle and techno
Crown window icon and the Holy Lois: Reborn window title
Server: /structures tells you which structure you are standing in
Server: an outdated pack gets a clear "update in the Holy Lois launcher" message instead of errors
removed: Server: the recovery compass recipe (your death point is on the minimap)
updated: R on an item shows its recipe, R on an empty slot sorts, never both
A broken tool is replaced by the same kind of tool, unenchanted and most worn first, with a soft chime instead of the alarm
Enchantment descriptions show only while you hold Shift
No more flickering lines between glass blocks with shaders
First person: the body sits a little further forward and stays out of view while you sleep
The game keeps 30 FPS in the background (was 1) and the recipe list scrolls instead of using pages
Clicking a command in chat (tpa accept, homes, warps) runs it right away without the confirm screen
Server: with several homes, /home goes to the one named home (any capitals); names that differ only in capitals are refused, and /Home works too
Server: walking back through a Nether portal takes you to the portal you came from
Server: world border 20000 (10000 blocks out from the centre); the land is pre-generated while the server is empty and the web map follows the border
Tab shows the player count like the server list
Correction: the world map opens with J (the 1.7.4 notes said M). Claiming needs no team; name your land with ' then Player config then Claimed Area Name

history.summary: Land and zones: claim land right on the map, see whose land you are on, and fair fights.
added: Land claims on the world map (Open Parties and Claims): press M, right-click a chunk and claim it. 16 chunks free, more by playing or with coins (/claims)
Teams: /oparties create and /oparties invite NAME, your team can build on your land
Zone titles at the top of the screen: the biome and whose land you are on (or Wilderness)
Server: /support MESSAGE reaches pjampjam on Discord right away, /report for problems with players, /donate for the wallets
updated: /rtp never drops you into or next to someone's land
PvP: logging out during a fight kills you, PvP deaths leave the loot for the winner and add no minimap death marker
Normal deaths: your drops stay 30 minutes and only you can pick them up for the first 5

history.summary: Achievement tabs really switch now, and a placed boombox looks like a boombox.
added: Server: /support also lists TRON, labels Bitcoin as SegWit and explains each network when you hover it
updated: Achievement tabs switch with a left click again (1.7.2 broke them for everyone, sorry about that)
A placed boombox shows its real texture instead of a pink and black cube
Game and mod text uses plain hyphens everywhere

history.summary: Set your boombox down, achievement tabs that work, daily coin button and smarter tool swapping.
added: Boombox: set it down on any block and it keeps playing for everyone nearby (right-click to switch station, sneak with an empty hand to turn it off)
Server: a [Claim] button for your daily coins when you log in, /support, and seven new achievements
removed: The extra "Hold Shift" enchantment line (descriptions show directly)
updated: Achievement tabs switch again with Num Lock or Caps Lock on, and Holy Lois comes first, then the vanilla tabs in order
Game music pauses while a boombox plays nearby; a dropped boombox stops right away
Recipe viewer: the item list appears only while you search, and the developer Tags tab is hidden
Plain tools are used until they break and then swapped; enchanted gear is swapped just before it breaks, with an alert
First-person body sits a little further back, so looking down no longer shows the inside of your neck

history.summary: Fixes chests showing a second lid or flickering.
updated: Chests use vanilla rendering again, so the lid opens cleanly with or without shaders

history.summary: Boombox radio, daily gifts and the Holy Lootbox, achievements, an auction house, holiday decorations, recipe viewer and many fixes.
added: Holy Lois Extras: a boombox that plays internet radio to everyone nearby through voice chat
Macaw's Holidays: Christmas trees, lights, garlands, presents and Halloween decorations
Roughly Enough Items: look up any recipe, including cooking and furniture
Legendary Tooltips, LambDynamicLights, Falling Leaves, Continuity, Status Effect Bars, Shulker Box Tooltip, Controlling and Clumps
Server: daily login gifts with a Holy Lootbox every 7th day, a Holy Lois achievement tab, an auction house (/ah), Tab leaderboards, structure discoveries, holiday events and death coordinates
removed: Server: quote of the day and the bot wall page in Tab
Vein mining shapes other than shapeless
updated: Descriptions for 19 modded enchantments
Minimap uses vanilla map colors and removes a death point when you reach it
Fixed chest flicker with shaders, key clashes (J opens the world map again) and the mod count on the title screen
Time and weather pause while nobody is online; the player locator bar is off

history.summary: New dungeons, taverns and towns to explore, custom music discs and small fixes.
added: Server: Dungeons and Taverns plus Towns and Towers in newly explored land, with Runeforged loot in their chests
Server: custom music on discs and goat horns with /audioplayer (plays through voice chat)
updated: MoreCulling 1.9.0 (final release) and CreativeCore 2.14.19
One sleeping player now skips the night
Tab list: Latvian name days and the daily bot wall

history.summary: Cooking, furniture, maps and a new look for the player list.
added: Farmer's Delight: cutting board, knife, cooking pot, burgers, sushi rolls, pumpkin slices and new crops
Macaw's Furniture: chairs you can sit on, tables, drawers, wardrobes and kitchen cabinets
Xaero's Minimap and World Map (J opens the map, Y minimap settings, U waypoints, Z larger minimap)
Jade: shows what you are looking at, including crop growth and container contents
updated: Hold Tab for server stats, ping, playtime and the quote of the day
Right-click ripe crops to harvest and replant them

history.summary: Shader-aware distant terrain, consistent first-person controls and quieter inventory defaults.
updated: Distant Horizons uses automatic shader-aware overdraw prevention.
PageDown switches between the visible first-person body and the normal hand view.
Inventory profile selectors and matching-item highlights are hidden; sorting stays available.
Durability tooltips show remaining/max without enabling advanced tooltips.
